acceptance_criteria.alternative_power: Descriptive power curve only; no minimum power criterion was stated by the architecture plan, and none is added here.
acceptance_criteria.null_gate: PASS only if one-sided exact 95% upper bound for FPR <=0.06 separately at all three shot counts; otherwise FAIL.
acceptance_criteria.resource_gate: Exactly 12,000 pairs planned and maximum; abort on exceeding 600 seconds, 256 MiB traced memory, or 256 MiB serialized output.

endpoint: Two-sample observable-distribution anomaly flag from src/quantum_simulator/statistics.py::compare_distributions; empirical TVD > max(0.05, 1/sqrt(shots)).
hypothesis: Under independent multinomial sampling from the specified four-outcome null, the existing TVD guard's one-sided exact 95% upper false-positive bound is <=0.06 at each shot count; power will increase with effect size and generally with shot count, reported descriptively.
limitations: Synthetic multinomial distributions only; not a circuit simulation or independent quantum execution.
No QMutBench, program mutation, family, diagnosis, physical hardware, or generalization claim.
The existing detector threshold is heuristic; this experiment estimates its operating behavior only under the registered synthetic distributions.
Exact binomial intervals quantify replicate-level Monte Carlo uncertainty, not uncertainty over quantum circuits or families.

metrics.alternatives: Detection proportion and two-sided exact 95% Clopper-Pearson interval for each effect x shot cell.
metrics.null: False-positive proportion and one-sided exact 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound for each shot count.
metrics.shot_sensitivity: Compare cell-level null FPR and alternative power across shot counts; no pooling across shots.

sampling.count_pair_definition: One pair is one independent reference multinomial count vector plus one independent submitted multinomial count vector at the same shot count and condition.
sampling.seed_policy: For each stream use first 32 bits (big-endian) of SHA-256 over UTF-8 protocol_id|shot_count|condition_id|replicate_index|stream_role; stream_role is reference or submitted. Seed each NumPy default_rng independently.

threshold_selection.evaluation_draws: All registered replicates; threshold fixed before these draws.
threshold_selection.rule: No threshold selection. Reuse the existing fixed threshold=0.05 and the existing max(threshold,1/sqrt(shots)) guard; do not tune on development or evaluation draws.

title: Preregistered synthetic finite-shot characterization of existing TVD guard
